notesStmt.note: A relatively clean manuscript of "Shakspere's Cipher," which first appeared in The Cosmopolitan in October 1887, where it was titled "Shakspere-Bacon's Cipher." In early September 1887, Whitman had first submitted the poem to McClure's Magazine and Harper's New Monthly Magazine, which both rejected it. He sent it to Cosmospolitan on September 13. Since this mauscript contains instructions for a printer, it likely that it dates from late August or early September 1887, when Whitman almost certainly had the poem set up in type before submitting it for publication, as was his practice.
"Shakespere-Bacon's Cipher" was first published in The Cosmopolitan in October 1887, and then included in Good-Bye My Fancy (1891).
